learned: 2026-10-08, agent pass: the brand's own site (cannabalsny.com) has no catalog (a two-blurb /products/ page from 2023, 4 'Sample Product' posts, no Shopify or WooCommerce). Its /cirona-labs-onboarding/ page links the distributor's 'Product Purchase Menu', a link-shared Google Sheet 'CANNABALS Fall 2026' with a DOWNSTATE WAREHOUSE and an UPSTATE WAREHOUSE tab (about 130 rows each, Cannabals, Kingsroad and Layup sections). Read through Google's gviz JSON endpoint, no login. The older /cirona-labs-menu/ page on the site is a stale (Sept 2024) copy of the same sheet and is not used. 2026-10-08, curation pass: Cirona's 'NYS Wholesale Catalog Winter-Spring 2025' PDF (Drive folder 'Catalogs' linked from /cirona-labs-onboarding/) confirms the lines: BRICK by Cannabals (p4: Blue Raspberry, Strawberry Banana; Live Resin Tropical Blast, Strawberry Lemonade, Lychee, Orange Soda; Pina Colada 2:1 THC:THC-V 'Energizing', Blueberry Dreams 1:1 THC:CBN 'For Sleep'), Mood State all-in-one vapes (p6) and Mood State gummies (p7, 10 gummies 100mg THC; Blueberry Dreams 20 gummies 100mg THC), Liquid Diamond 2g all-in-ones (p8), PUFFS by Cannabals diamond infused pre-rolls 3.5g 7 pack (p9), CONES by Cannabals 10mg per cone, 100mg per bag (p10). Store package photos confirm the Chubby Puff '6g THC' disposable and the Brick as '1 gummy bar, 10 pieces per bar, 100mg'.
notes: The sheet is Cirona Labs' wholesale menu for New York dispensaries (OCM-PROC-24-000051), one product per row under section header rows (a row with no price). It is one sheet for three brands: the Cannabals rows are kept by their Category column; Kingsroad (concentrates, 2 and 14 pack pre-rolls, 2G live resin AIOs) and Layup (cans) are skipped. Kingsroad's 2G AiO rows share the Category '2G AiO' with Cannabals' Liquid Diamond rows and are told apart by THC: Cannabals' are all 90%, Kingsroad's 74-82% or blank. A Cannabals 2G AiO row with no THC would be skipped by mistake and show in the skipped count.

Both tabs are read: downstate and upstate carry the same catalog and differ in stock and a few spellings; the newest rows (Pumpkin Spice Latte cones, Kush Mintz and Apple Fritter 1g, Jack Herer 6g) are on both. A product on both tabs is one entry. Stock status is ignored: out-of-stock is a warehouse state, not a discontinued product.
The link in the onboarding page points at a third tab (gid 1872949893) that is an older copy of the downstate tab; it is not read.

Sizes are fixed by the format column: 1G / 2G / 6G AiO, a pre-roll pack is '7 pack .5g' = 3.5g, gummies and cones are 100mg THC packs ('100mg 10 Pack' = 10pk 100mg, Blueberry Dreams '100mg 20 Pack'), a Brick is one 100mg 'Scored Gummy'.

Lines: Chubby Puff (6G AiO), Puffs (the infused pre-rolls; the sheet never says Puffs, every store and the retailer pages do), Mood State (the 1G AiOs with an effect in the strain column, and the gummies priced with a ratio: Mimosa THC + THC-V 2:1 and so on) and Brick (the 100mg Scored Gummy bars, so Strawberry Lemonade Brick and Strawberry Lemonade 10pk gummy are two products). Liquid Diamond (the 2G AiOs: the sheet's '2G Liquid Diamond Disposable Vape' section, the wholesale PDF's 'Liquid Diamond All-in-One Vapes', and every store) and Live Resin (the five '- Live Resin' fast-acting gummies: Frose, Dragonfruit Lemonade, Pineapple Passionfruit, Tangerine Guava, Strawberry Lemonade; the sheet's 'Live Resin Fast Acting Gummy' section and the PDF's 'Infused with Live Resin' group) are lines too: the brand groups them as families (owner, 2026-10-10, reversing the earlier 'extract, not a line'). The plain fast-acting gummies and the 1G core AiOs have no family name and keep no line.
Mood State effects (Party, Energy, Recovery, Calm, Sleep) are not put in the strain; stores name these products by flavour (Mood State Mimosa, Tahiti Lime).

Title fixes: 'Granddaddy Purp' is Granddaddy Purple, 'Pinacolada' is Pina Colada, 'LCG' is Lemon Cherry Gelato, 'BlackBerry Brain' is Blackberry Brain, 'Dragonfruit Lemonades' (typo on one tab) is Dragonfruit Lemonade, 'White Chocoalte' (typo on one tab) is White Chocolate.

Cones are chocolate-coated ice cream cone tips sold as 10 x 10mg. Their names are the flavours as the sheet writes them (Mint, Caramel Espresso, Cookies & Cream); stores add 'Chocolate' to Mint and Caramel Espresso, mapped with store_aliases. Stores whose own subtype guess for 'Cookies & Cream' and 'Caramel Espresso' cones is 'other' (no 'chocolate' in the name) are the same cones; store_skip drops them.

Match terms: a Live Resin gummy and the Live Resin Brick of the same flavour (Strawberry Lemonade) share the sheet's title, so they share a match term; they differ by line (Brick) and size (10pk 100mg against 100mg).

Mood State is the brand's own family across two formats (catalog p6 vapes, p7 gummies), so the cross-category line is meant. The effect bricks (Blueberry Dreams Sleep, Pina Colada Energy) are Bricks, not Mood State: the catalog's BRICK page lists them; one store's description says 'Mood State Brick' and is not followed.

store_aliases names hold the store spellings confirmed against the sheet and the catalog: LCG (the brand's own short name, printed on the Puffs jar), Pumpkin Spice (the sheet's only pumpkin cone, Pumpkin Spice Latte), 'Belgian' chocolate cones (the bag says 'filled with real Belgian chocolate'), Blue Razz (stores paste the brand's 'Blue Razz Brick Gummies' blurb). Each is one store today; they keep a second store from making a store-only copy.
